Two article links lead to missing pages

Two article URLs return 404 from eight links, including a missing prosthodontist guide still listed in the XML sitemap.

  • Redirect the singular implant-pros-and-cons URL to its verified plural article and update all four source links directly.
  • Restore the prosthodontist guide or retire its links/XML entry after review; no equivalent replacement is verified.

02

Schema mixes office and page identities

One primary practice has 225 changing Dentist IDs, and 122 article graphs reuse those business IDs as WebPage identities.

  • Use one stable primary #dentist ID with the homepage URL; keep page IDs separate and consolidate redundant Organization output.
  • Correct Micheal → Michael and DDS → DMD, use an absolute logo URL, and update the supported primary review count from 38 to 42.
03

Blog pages point their canonical to page one

Blog pages 2–11 show different articles but all declare /blog/ as their canonical URL.

  • Give each retained archive page its own matching canonical and keep its crawlable next/previous links; no new menu items are needed.
04

Full-mouth implants needs a clearer page purpose

The full-mouth implant page describes single-tooth replacement and general restoration, despite a separate full-mouth restoration page.

  • Focus this page on approved implant-based full-arch choices and stages, linking to the broader restoration page where relevant; do not merge them without intent/traffic review.
05

An article still uses legacy practice wording

The facial-prosthesis article’s call-to-action names Villa Canyon Prosthodontics rather than the current primary site brand.

  • Confirm the legacy/current brand relationship, then update retired practice self-references on the seven mapped articles while preserving intentional history and the separate Laser brand.

Fix order

Repair broken journeys and shared source data first, then resolve page purpose and naming.

  • Website + SEO: exact link/redirect map, one schema package, archive canonicals and verified sitemap-submission cleanup.
  • Content + client: missing-guide decision, full-mouth page scope and approved legacy-brand wording.

Guide restoration and legacy-brand wording need decisions. Current-period GSC data ends with an incomplete day. Speed attribution and wider optional work are retained in the full report; no live changes made.
